hybrid-memory.quote: Dense vectors + sparse vectors (SPLADE, BGE-M3) + native BM25 full-text search, fused via configurable reranking
hybrid-memory.reason: Shows a production way to combine lexical BM25 and embedding search, a useful comparison point for adding semantic search on top of lexical search.

local-llm.quote: detects hardware (RAM, CPU, GPU/VRAM, and backend), then scores every model in its catalog across four dimensions — memory fit, estimated speed, quality, and context length
local-llm.reason: Recommends which models fit a 16/24/48 GB GPU, and weighs context length as one of the factors.

local-llm.quote: 262K native context, native Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) support
local-llm.reason: A Qwen3.8-27B variant tuned for agent coding work, with a long context and GGUF files for local inference.
Its quantization tools and pre-quantized Qwen3.8 checkpoints can help fit models onto 16–48 GB GPUs.

hybrid-memory.quote: instead of RAG (re-deriving knowledge from raw sources on every query), have the LLM incrementally build and maintain a persistent wiki
hybrid-memory.reason: The foundational pattern that compares linked-markdown wiki memory against RAG.

wiki-scale.quote: lint (health-check for contradictions, orphans, stale claims)
wiki-scale.reason: Defines the ingest, query, and lint operations a wiki-scale benchmark would time and test.

organize.quote: LLM does the bookkeeping, human does the thinking
organize.reason: A simple, clearly explained pattern for keeping notes and sources in an LLM-maintained wiki.

hybrid-memory.quote: maintains a live knowledge graph of tasks, dependencies, decisions, and execution records, then delivers the right context shape for each task's current stage
hybrid-memory.reason: Another memory/context system for coding agents that uses a graph-server design, not file-based records.

agent-viz.quote: runs multiple coding agents in parallel, each in its own isolated git worktree, with results tracked in a unified UI
agent-viz.reason: Gives one view of agents running in parallel and sends notifications when agents finish, close to the live view the brief asks for.

local-llm.quote: 75–95% cache hit rates on multi-turn agent conversations with shared system prompts
local-llm.reason: A serving engine for running open-weight models on a local GPU; its prefix-cache reuse helps long-context agent sessions.
